name: PartialFrobenius.frobenius_preserves_form
statement: theorem frobenius_preserves_form : ∀ a b c d : Fin 4, omega (frobenius4 (a,b)) (frobenius4 (c,d))=omega (a,b) (c,d)

name: PartialFrobenius.partial_preserves_product_form
statement: theorem partial_preserves_product_form (p q : V4 × V4) : productForm (partialAction p) (partialAction q)=productForm p q

name: PartialFrobenius.finite_sign_orbit
statement: theorem finite_sign_orbit : (∀ a b : Fin 4, iterate frobenius4 3 (a,b)=opposite4 (a,b)) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 4, iterate frobenius4 6 (a,b)=(a,b)) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, (∃ a b : Fin 4, iterate frobenius4 (k.val+1) (a,b)≠(a,b)) ∧ (∃ a b : Fin 4, iterate frobenius4 (k.val+1) (a,b)≠opposite4 (a,b)))

name: PartialFrobenius.public_inverse_halves_quarters
statement: theorem public_inverse_halves_quarters {M : Type} [IntModule M] (killed : ∀ x : M, (12317 : Int) • x=0) : (∀ x : M, (6159 : Int) • ((2 : Int) • x)=x) ∧ (∀ x : M, (9238 : Int) • ((4 : Int) • x)=x)

name: PartialFrobenius.rational_bridge_agreement
statement: theorem rational_bridge_agreement {J E T : Type} [IntModule T] (n r : Int) (norm : J → E) (pull : E → T) (phi : E → E) (transfer : J → T) (fixed : ∀ x, phi (norm x)=norm x) (cleared : ∀ x, n • transfer x=pull (phi (norm x))) (inverse : ∀ y : T, r • (n • y)=y) : ∀ x, transfer x=r • pull (norm x)
